401540101.text: You continue to run the potion shop. Thanks to all your hard work, your earnings surpass expectations...

401540102.text: Wow, I have to hand it to you, cuties. I never imagined that you'd be able to bring in so much Mora in such a short amount of time...

401540103.text: You're practically geniuses when it comes to business.

401540106.text: Although, with results this impressive, I would say you could stand to take a bit more credit.

401540109.text: If I had your help all the time, I bet I could take double the amount of vacation without a care in the world.

401540110.text: With all your hard work up to this point, we've already collected enough sales data for our research. Thank you so much for all your help.

401540111.text: Of course, if you're interested in continuing to run the shop, you'd make me a very happy Lisa.

401540112.text: In either case, I should already have more than enough to report back to Jean with.

401540113.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a long time.

401540115.text: Oh, you're here! I wrapped up some business with my cuties, and was just about to go report back to you at headquarters.

401540116.text: No need. I already talked to some other knights, so I think I have fairly good understanding of the situation.

401540117.text: #Looks like you've troubled {NICKNAME} to help you once again?

401540118.text: Hehe, how could I not? When it comes to work as important as this, a smart and capable partner is simply a must have — especially if we want good results.

401540119.text: Look at the success of the shop! I could have never produced that kind of result on my own.

401540120.text: Well, I do have to admit, your success is remarkable.

401540121.text: I've been meaning to come see you for some time now, but work kept getting in the way, and I simply couldn't find the time... Regardless, I just knew I had to come thank you in person.

401540108.text: Hm, a testament to your ability to learn on the job.
